data.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Has Lost Its China AI Accelerator Market
data.description: Nvidia (NasdaqGS:NVDA) has effectively lost its China AI accelerator market after U.S. export controls restricted advanced GPU shipments. Specialist financiers are structuring large facilities backed by Nvidia GPU inventory, treating high-end chips as core collateral for AI infrastructure projects. Enterprise customers are rolling out liquid-cooled, rack-scale agentic AI factories, including deployments built around Supermicro server platforms. The collapse of Nvidia's China AI accelerator...
